strengths.strength: Strong attacking output for a defender
strengths.evidence: 6 assists and 29 chances created in 1,260 minutes indicate a consistent contribution to attacking play from a full-back position.
45 tackles won and 36 interceptions over the sample show a high volume of successful defensive actions.
38 successful dribbles suggests confidence and success in beating opponents in possession.

development_areas.evidence: 83% pass completion, which alongside a high chance-creation and dribbling output, may indicate a tendency toward riskier or lower-percentage passing.
development_areas.suggested_action: Work on decision-making around pass selection to balance progressive passing with retaining possession.

development_areas.area: Goal output relative to attacking involvement
development_areas.evidence: Only 2 goals despite 29 chances created and 38 successful dribbles, suggesting limited end product when arriving in advanced areas.
development_areas.suggested_action: Targeted finishing and final-third decision-making practice to convert advanced positions into shooting opportunities.

recommended_role.role: Attacking left-back in a possession-based system
recommended_role.reason: The combination of 6 assists, 29 chances created, and 38 successful dribbles points to a player suited to a role with license to join attacks and create chances from wide areas, while 45 tackles won and 36 interceptions support defensive responsibilities in such a system.

limitations: Analysis is based on a single season/sample of statistics (1,260 minutes) with no data on consistency over time.
No positional or league-average benchmarks were provided, so it is not possible to contextualise how these numbers compare to peers.
No data provided on defensive errors, cards, aerial duels, or physical metrics (e.g. speed, distance covered).
No qualitative or video-based information (decision-making under pressure, positioning, communication) is included.
No injury, fitness, or attitude data is available, and none has been assumed.
Statistics do not indicate quality of opposition faced or match context (e.g. score state, formation).
